# W7 handoff: metadata, Ollama and community

Branch `ws/w7-metadata`, from the phase 0 commit `b3ed701`. Requests for the integration lead are in [`requests/w7.md`](../requests/w7.md).

## Done, by feature ID

| Feature | What exists | Where |
|---|---|---|
| META-1 | Index of every Commit: formats (GGUF, safetensors, MLX by the 07 rule, ONNX, PyTorch, TensorFlow, Flax, Core ML, OpenVINO, TFLite), architecture and model type, parameters in total and per dtype (root-level safetensors, or the preferred GGUF quant), quantisations (GGUF groups with `general.file_type`, MLX bits and group size), context length, chat template (GGUF, `tokenizer_config.json` string or named list, `chat_template.jinja`, `chat_template.json`), BOS and EOS tokens, safe card front matter, licence (card, else an SPDX-style match of a `LICENSE*` file), pipeline tag and library (card first, then inferred), tags, total and present size, per-file info, the Hub's `gguf` and `config` fields, and the dataset fields W7 can derive (formats, modalities, card fields, Configs and Splits through a hook). Headers are read with ranged 1 MiB windows; a malformed file gives a per-file error. Results are keyed by `(repo, commit, indexer_version)`, readers get the newest version, and `ReindexStale` re-queues branch heads after a version bump. The `index` Job handler emits `index.completed`. | `internal/index`, `internal/index/indexdb`, `internal/index/{safetensors,gguf,card,rangeio}` |
| META-2 | Pickle scanner: opcodes of protocols 0 to 5 with stack and memo tracking for `STACK_GLOBAL`, `GLOBAL` and `INST`; allow and deny lists with sources; partial wrappers; legacy PyTorch files (five pickles); zip-based PyTorch archives (ranged reads of the central directory and `.pkl` members only when scanning a Commit, a local-header stream for `ScanFile`); `.npy` object arrays; joblib with zlib, gzip and bz2. Per-file and Repo status, stored per scanner version, with `RescanStale`. The `scan` Job handler emits `scan.completed` with the flagged files. | `internal/scan`, `internal/scan/pickle`, `docs/research/pickle-scanning.md` |
| META-3 | Integrity: safetensors (header JSON, dtypes, offsets in range, no overlaps, full coverage, exact file size), GGUF (magic, version, known tensor types, aligned offsets inside the file) and LFS pointer size against the stored object (and a missing object). | `internal/scan` |
| DOWN-4 | Ollama registry: `/v2/token`, `GET`/`HEAD` manifests by quant, `latest` (Q4_K_M or the closest in 08's order) or filename; model, projector, template (Repo `template` or matched from `tokenizer.chat_template` with Ollama's index and distance rule), system, params (Repo `params`, else the matched template's stop tokens) and licence layers; a deterministic config blob; generated blobs in `ollama_blobs`; blobs streamed with ranges and a signed same-host `Location` for Ollama's part downloads; the 401 challenge with a request-host realm; 404 `MANIFEST_UNKNOWN` naming the Pull for a Partial mirror, or 503 with `Retry-After` through Pull-through; a clear error for split GGUF quants; 405 for push. | `internal/ollama`, `compat/ollama` |
| REPO-6 (core) | Discussions and pull requests: numbering per Repo, comments, renames, status changes, comment edit and hide, discard, merge as one Commit `"<title> (#N)"` of the pull request's changes since its fork point, refused with `ErrConflict` when the base changed the same files, files-changed summaries, and `discussion.created`, `discussion.commented`, `discussion.status_changed` and `pr.merged` webhooks. Native API `/repos/.../discussions`. | `internal/community`, `internal/community/communitydb`, `internal/api/discussions.go` |
| REPO-7 (core) | Likes (idempotent), likers and liked-by, daily download counts with an upsert, native `/like` and `/stats` (zero-filled days). | `internal/community/communitydb`, `internal/api/metadata.go` |
| BROWSE-5 | Collections: title slugs, visibility (public, internal, private to Namespace members), write access through `auth.Authz` on the Namespace, items checked to exist and hidden from viewers who cannot read them, ordering and notes, filters by owner, item and title. Native `/collections` API. The Hub endpoints are W4's, on the same `collections.Service`. | `internal/collections`, `internal/api/collections.go` |
| EVT-1 | Webhooks: registration per Namespace or Repo with sealed secrets, `Emit` that records a delivery per matching webhook and queues a `webhook.deliver` Job, signed deliveries (`X-Hangar-Signature`, `X-Hangar-Event`, `X-Hangar-Delivery`), a 10-second timeout, retries at 1 minute, 5 minutes, 30 minutes, 2 hours and 12 hours then failed, the delivery log, redelivery, ping tests, no redirects, no URLs in errors, private targets refused at connect time when `webhooks.allow_private_targets` is off, secret re-encryption for key rotation, and audit events for changes. Native `/webhooks` API. | `internal/webhook`, `internal/api/webhooks.go` |

The interfaces in `index`, `scan`, `community`, `collections` and `webhook` are unchanged apart from the additions in requests 6 and 7, and every fake still satisfies them.

## Definition of done

| Item | Evidence |
|---|---|
| Parser fuzz targets | `FuzzRead` (safetensors), `FuzzRead` (GGUF), `FuzzFromReadme` (card front matter), `FuzzScan` (pickle) and `FuzzScanFile` (scanner by file type), each with seeds in code and a corpus in `testdata/fuzz/`. Each ran for 20 seconds with no failure (`go test ./internal/scan/pickle -run '^$' -fuzz FuzzScan -fuzztime 20s`, and the same for the others); `make fuzz` runs them all. |
| Index output for every fixture against golden files | `TestIndexMatchesGoldenFiles` in `internal/index` indexes 11 fixture Repos (BERT, sharded GPT-2 with PyTorch and ONNX files, Llama with a named chat template list and a licence file, GGUF quants with a split group and a projector, a Partial mirror, MLX, sentence-transformers, diffusers, malformed files, other formats with a PEFT adapter, and a dataset) through `indexdb.Service` on SQLite and Postgres and compares them with `internal/index/testdata/golden/*.json`. Regenerate with `go test ./internal/index -run TestIndexMatchesGoldenFiles -update`. |
| Pickle scanner catches malicious fixtures and passes benign ones | `TestScanClassifiesImports`, `TestScanFollowsBackToBackPickles` (`internal/scan/pickle`) and `TestScanFileByType`, `TestScanCommitStoresResults` (`internal/scan`). Fixtures are built in `scantest/pickles.go` and were checked with Python's `pickletools.dis` and NumPy: `os.system` (protocol 0), `posix.system` through the memo, `subprocess.Popen` by `INST`, `__builtin__.eval`, `functools.partial(os.system)`, a computed `STACK_GLOBAL`, inside legacy PyTorch files, zip archives (stored and deflated), `.npy` object arrays and compressed joblib files; benign torch state dicts in all three containers, protocol 4 NumPy pickles and float arrays pass. |
| `compat/ollama` green | `go test -tags compat -count=1 ./compat/ollama/` with Ollama 0.31.1: pull by `latest` and by quant, show, a one-token generation, a missing quant, a private Repo with a registered key, and no redirects. Also green in a throwaway merge with W1 to W5 using W5's real `auth.Service` for authentication, authorisation and Ollama key verification. |
| Webhook signing and retries | `TestEmitSignsAndDelivers`, `TestRetriesFollowTheScheduleThenFail`, `TestTestDeliveryAndPrivateTargets`, `TestUnreachableReceiverErrorsHideTheURL` and `TestHandleJobEdgeCases` (`internal/webhook`), on SQLite and Postgres, with a fake clock driving the schedule through `jobstest.Fake`. |
| `make lint test` | Green in the worktree with Node 24 first on `PATH`. |

Coverage (`go test -cover`): `index` 88.8 %, `index/indexdb` and the parsers 87 to 97 %, `scan` 80 %, `scan/pickle` 94.6 %, `webhook` 88.2 %, `community/communitydb` 84 %, `collections` 88.4 %, `ollama` 80.3 %, W7's `internal/api` handlers 80.1 %, and every `*test` helper package above 75 %.

## Known gaps

- `compat/ollama` was run with a local Ollama 0.31.1 binary, not the `ollama/ollama:0.31.1` image (2.8 GB for arm64, too large for the shared machine). The image path (`docker run` with `host.docker.internal:host-gateway`, `docker exec`) is written but has not been run; CI will be its first run.
- The compat suite builds its own in-process Instance from the Repo fake, because `cmd/hangar` does not wire the Ollama handler yet. After phase 2 wiring it should also run against the binary through `compat/harness`.
- Ollama 0.31.1 cannot pull split GGUF models; Hangar refuses them with an error that says so. Supporting them needs merging the parts on the fly or a newer Ollama.
- DATA-9 dataset metadata in the index is partial: formats, modalities, task categories, languages, size category and pretty name are filled; Configs and Splits only when `indexdb.Options.Layout` is wired (W10); rows and bytes per Split and the models that list a dataset are not computed here.
- Parameter counts for PyTorch-only Repos are not computed (the scanner never unpickles tensors). Repos with both safetensors and GGUF files count safetensors.
- The licence match recognises 30 common licences by phrase; anything else is left unset unless the card names it.
- joblib files with NumPy arrays embedded in the pickle stream end in an `error` result after their imports, and xz and lz4 joblib files are not scanned. `.npz` files are not scanned.
- Webhook payloads are stored in `webhook_deliveries` and kept; there is no pruning of old deliveries.
- `GET /webhooks` with no filter lists the webhooks of Namespaces the caller administers and of up to 500 Repos in them; Instance admins do not get every webhook.

## What the integration lead must wire

```go
// Index, scan, webhooks, community and Collections.
hooks := webhook.New(webhook.Options{DB: d, Queue: queue, Sealer: sealer, Instruments: tel.Instruments, Log: log,
    AllowPrivateTargets: settings.WebhooksAllowPrivateTargets, UserAgent: "Hangar/" + version})
indexer := indexdb.New(indexdb.Options{DB: d, Repos: repos, Webhooks: hooks, Instruments: tel.Instruments, Log: log,
    Layout: datasetsLayout /* W10 */, AfterIndex: queueDatasetConvert /* W10 */})
scanner := scan.New(scan.Options{DB: d, Repos: repos, LFS: lfsStore, Webhooks: hooks, Instruments: tel.Instruments, Log: log})
communitySvc := communitydb.New(communitydb.Options{DB: d, Repos: repos, Webhooks: hooks, Log: log})
collectionsSvc := collections.New(collections.Options{DB: d, Orgs: orgs, Repos: repos, Authz: authSvc.Authz()})

// Job handlers (every role that runs Jobs).
indexer.Register(registry)  // jobs.KindIndex
scanner.Register(registry)  // jobs.KindScan
hooks.Register(registry)    // jobs.KindWebhookDeliver
// On worker start, after a version change: indexer.ReindexStale(ctx, queue); scanner.RescanStale(ctx, queue)

// Native API: compose with the other workstreams' handler types.
deps := api.MetaDeps{Repos: repos, Authz: authSvc.Authz(), Orgs: orgs, Index: indexer, Scanner: scanner,
    Community: communitySvc, Collections: collectionsSvc, Webhooks: hooks, Audit: rec, Log: log}
// api.NewMetadataAPI(deps), api.NewCommunityAPI(deps), api.NewCollectionsAPI(deps), api.NewWebhooksAPI(deps)

// Ollama registry.
ollamaHandler, _ := ollama.New(ollama.Options{DB: d, Repos: repos, LFS: lfsStore, Authz: authSvc.Authz(),
    OllamaAuth: authSvc.Ollama, Signer: signer, PublicURL: cfg.Server.PublicURL, PullThrough: w6PullThrough,
    Community: communitySvc, Instruments: tel.Instruments, Log: log})
// httpx.Protocols{..., Ollama: ollamaHandler}
// httpx.Authenticate(ollama.ExemptTokenEndpoint(authSvc), auth.WriteAuthError(cfg.Server.PublicURL))
```

- Pass `hooks` as the `webhook.Emitter` to W2's `repo.Options.Webhooks` and to W6, and `indexer`, `scanner`, `communitySvc` and `collectionsSvc` to W2's `RepoDeps` and `repo.Options` and to W4's `hfapi.Deps`.
- W2 already queues `index` and `scan` Jobs with the payload `index.CommitJob` decodes and the dedupe key `<repo uuid>:<commit>`.
- `scan.block_unsafe_downloads` is enforced where files are downloaded (W4, W3, W8) from `scan.Scanner.Results`; `scan.Service.FileResult` gives one file's result.
- Run `compat/ollama` against the wired binary once phase 2 is done, and add it to the compat CI job with the pinned image.
